item.title: January sees big jump in EV sales in Galway
item.description: Car sales continued to rise in Galway in January, the busiest month of the year for the industry. A modest increase of 5% on last year’s figures, a little above the national average, saw the total number of new cars coming off the forecourts in the city and county rise to 1,600. item.title: Galway reveals high residential vacancy figures
item.description: Galway has recorded a significantly higher residential vacancy rate than the national average – despite the scale of the current housing crisis.
